name: host-adapter-critic-session
title: Require a host-adapter session to sign a topology-critic receipt
description: An implementer who also dispatches can currently mint a session id, record a dispatch event under it, hand that id to the critic subagent via LATTICE_SESSION_ID, and have independenceMatrix report session independence as true. Bind critic receipt signing to sessionSource host-adapter, which is derived from provider plus task plus agent identity and therefore cannot be chosen by the implementer.
